            body = ## Why (lodar, Telegram 2026-09-16 01:13Z)

> false notification - the agent was sitting on 'You've hit your org's monthly spend limit · ask your admin to raise it … your weekly limit resets Sep 19, 12pm (UTC)' - so the blocked-on-prompt is wrong and shouldnt be alarmed

Three FLEET-HEALTH blocked-on-prompt pages in one evening (quinn ~16:05Z, ops ~16:20Z, community ~01:00Z, all on the exhausted chemmonitor account) reached lodar's phone for the same non-event. Axis: the org layer's observable behaviour — a human paged for a hold that has its own resume time.

## Mechanism

When Claude Code hits a plan/org limit mid-turn it prints the refusal and renders ITS OWN three-option picker ("What do you want to do? 1. Stop and wait for limit to reset / 2. Wait here, then continue automatically at <time> / 3. Upgrade your plan", "Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel"). The watchdog's picker matcher keys on the confirm/cancel vocabulary, finds no "(Recommended)" mark, and escalates as "a person must choose" — the AskUserQuestion shape. It is not: it is a QUOTA hold with a resume time printed in the pane, and the safe answer is always option 2 (the seat parks and resumes at the reset). main answered quinn and ops by hand with `tmux send-keys Down Enter` (2026-09-15 16:xxZ); by the time community was read the picker had already dismissed itself and the pane showed the refusal + idle composer + `1w: 100%`.

## Fix (dev, cmd_supervisor.sh / fleet-health picker path)

1. Before the blocked-on-prompt arm, match the usage-limit picker (any of: "hit your org's monthly spend limit", "Usage limit reached", "Stop and wait for limit to reset", "continue automatically at") and classify the seat **quota-exhausted** with the resume time parsed from the pane — the class the supervisor already has (`quota-exhausted` in the tick summary) — not blocked-on-prompt.
2. Answer it: press Down, Enter (option 2, "Wait here, then continue automatically") as the seat's own user; that is the documented self-heal ("continuing automatically at HH:MM" then appears on the status line). Never Escape (leaves the seat stopped).
3. No human page for this class. One digest line per seat per window at most; the tick summary already counts them.
4. Test arms: a pane fixture with the limit picker → classified quota-exhausted, keypress sent, no escalate; a real AskUserQuestion picker fixture → still escalates; the DIVE-4536 lesson stands — match the LIMIT vocabulary, and keep this row's own text out of any pane a seat renders (quoting the picker in a diff or reply pages the seat that quotes it).

Related: DIVE-4536 (picker matcher fires on quoted vocabulary), the quota-hold-is-keyed-on-pane-text note (main memory), 2026-09-15 supervisor rung-4 page on a reaped pool seat (same watcher family; not filed).
